title: Perfect
text:
I had a wonderful experience with Pepa during the visit to the Alcázar, the Cathedral, and the Jewish Quarter of Seville.
Pepa is an exceptional guide: cultured, passionate, and very interesting. Not only does she know the history and architecture of the city perfectly, but she also knows how to convey them in a lively, clear, and engaging manner.

title: Great tour
text: Very interesting and informative.  Manuel was very knowledgeable and thorough. Was worried about walking for 4 hours but the pace was easily manageable. We covered almost every area we wanted to. Lunch recommendation was bang on! Probably one of our best meals.
